title: Carryover Balances
pageSubtitle: Settle aggregate teacher payouts and convert them to expenses.
empty: No carryover records match the current filters.
emptyStateHint: Try changing the filter criteria or add a new record manually.
loadError: Failed to load carryover balances. Please try again.
exportFailed: CSV export failed. Please try again.

bulkToExpense.title: Convert to expenses
bulkToExpense.convertConsequenceWarning: This will create one expense row per carryover and mark them as paid. Linked sessions become paid.
bulkToExpense.convertFillRequiredHint: Fill the required fields above to convert.

groupedSummary.__fn: (sessions,balances)=>{const sessionPart=sessions===1?"1 audited session":`${sessions} audited sessions`;const balancePart=balances===1?"1 carryover balance":`${balances} carryover balances`;return`${sessionPart} will be grouped into ${balancePart}.`}

bulkCreate.groupedConsequence: Sessions will move to the waiting-for-payment state.

form.teacherLockedHint: The teacher cannot be changed; delete and recreate the record instead.

linkedSessionsWarning.__fn: count=>{if(count===1){return"This carryover has 1 linked session. Deleting it unlinks the session and restores its previous audit status."}return`This carryover has ${count} linked sessions. Deleting it unlinks them and restores their previous audit status.`}

unpay.title: Unpay this carryover balance?
unpay.warning: The linked expense will be soft-deleted and the linked sessions will revert to awaiting payment.
unpay.notePlaceholder: Explain why this carryover is being unpaid (max 2,000 characters)

sessionsHeading.__fn: count=>{if(count===0)return"No linked sessions";if(count===1)return"1 linked session";return`${count} linked sessions`}

drawer.noSessions: No sessions are linked to this carryover balance.
drawer.subject: Subject

validation.dateRangeInvalid: The from date must be on or before the to date.
validation.noteTooLong: Note must be 2,000 characters or fewer.

error.alreadyPaid: One or more carryovers are already paid.

bulkCreated.__fn: count=>{if(count===0)return"No carryover balances created.";if(count===1)return"1 carryover balance created.";return`${count} carryover balances created.`}

bulkDeleted.__fn: count=>{if(count===0)return"No carryover balances deleted.";if(count===1)return"1 carryover balance deleted.";return`${count} carryover balances deleted.`}

bulkedToExpense.__fn: count=>{if(count===0)return"No expenses created.";if(count===1)return"1 expense created.";return`${count} expenses created.`}

paidCount.__fn: count=>{if(count===0)return"No paid carryovers";if(count===1)return"1 paid carryover";return`${count} paid carryovers`}

unpaidCount.__fn: count=>{if(count===0)return"No unpaid carryovers";if(count===1)return"1 unpaid carryover";return`${count} unpaid carryovers`}
